description: Locate every reference to a symbol across a tree. The system prompt tells the model to bulk-discover with Grep rather than walking the tree a file at a time; this checks it does.
setup: printf 'import { parseConfig } from "../a/config.js";\nexport const load = (s) => parseConfig(s);\n' > src/b/load.js
printf 'import { parseConfig } from "../a/config.js";\nexport const boot = (s) => parseConfig(s);\n' > src/c/boot.js
